decision.controlled_failure: Reject this first-delivery realization contract. Do not sweep target percentages, split percentages or MFE thresholds.
decision.implementation_failure: Repair only the concrete execution/evidence defect and rerun the exact same frozen ablation; do not change any alpha variable.
decision.improved_but_insufficient: Record which realization component improved, but do not promote or validate it. Replace the next causally identified market-state or realization assumption rather than fitting numbers.
decision.retain_diagnostic_only: Retain the causal first-delivery/runner mechanism for a separately defined DEVELOPMENT candidate, then freeze it before untouched validation. This opened-data result itself cannot advance or claim alpha.

mechanism_contract.allocation: before venue rounding, primary=L/(L+G1) and runner=G1/(L+G1), where L is the inherited costed full stop loss per unit and G1 is costed first-delivery gain per unit
mechanism_contract.causal_guard: the first-delivery price must remain beyond the completed confirmation bar extreme and strictly before the inherited external target
mechanism_contract.entry: one and only one parent entry order
mechanism_contract.exits: after real fills, two reduce-only limit exits and one reduce-only protective stop are owned by NautilusTrader
fail_closed: missing parent order after a reported fill
mechanism_contract.fallback: if no causal first-delivery node exists or venue quantity/notional granularity cannot express both legs, preserve the inherited bracket rather than deleting the scenario
first_delivery_candidate_order: nearest still-live causally confirmed five-minute internal pivot formed after source-range completion
nearest still-live external pool on the route to the inherited target
mechanism_contract.liveness: internal pivots are invalid once crossed after becoming known; external pools use their existing consumed and expiry state
mechanism_contract.rounding: primary quantity is rounded upward to the venue increment, so realized first-delivery gain remains at least sufficient to finance the residual runner's inherited full costed loss under the planning assumptions
